title: Add GCM truncated-tag KAT (authTagSz < 16)
description: The test suite has no test vector exercising AES-GCM with authTagSz < 16 (truncated tag). The truncation path through the port is: GET_TAG sets tag_op.taglen = authTagSz, sim returns min(requested, stored), port checks tag_op.taglen == authTagSz. This was traced logically but never run against a known-answer vector. NIST SP 800-38D Appendix B provides vectors; truncation is valid down to 4 bytes per the spec. Add a test case to test_aesgcm_empty() or as a sibling: encrypt with authTagSz=12, compare ciphertext and tag against the NIST vector, then decrypt and verify. Absence of this test leaves the truncation path as reviewer-trusted-but-untested.
